폰앱, 와치앱 둘다 동일하게 동작하는거죠? 기기해제 버튼도 없는거죠?

> AGENT

정확히는 셋이 조금 다르게 동작합니다.

| 앱 | 기기 변경 방법 | 해제 버튼 |
|----|---------------|-----------|
| **와치앱 (Wear OS)** | 자동: 3s×2 실패 → 새 기기 등록 모드 | 없음 |
| **가민 (Monkey C)** | 자동: 3s×2 실패 → 새 기기 등록 모드 | 없음 |
| **폰앱 (Flutter)** | 수동: 사용자가 스캔 버튼 → 목록에서 선택 | 없음 |

**폰앱은 2-retry 로직이 없습니다.** 폰앱은 수동 UI가 있어서 필요가 없어요:
- 저장된 기기가 범위 안에 있으면 그것만 보여줌
- 없으면 모든 rLens 목록 표시 (fallback)
- 새 기기 등록 = 그냥 목록에서 새 기기 탭

와치앱·가민은 UI가 없으니 "못찾음 2회 → 자동으로 아무 rLens 수용" 방식이 해제 버튼의 역할을 합니다.

세 앱 모두 **기기 해제 버튼은 없습니다.**

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
Android(Wear OS 포함)는 설치 직후 앱을 `stopped=true` 상태로 시작합니다. 이는 배터리 절약을 위한 정책으로, 사용자가 명시적으로 실행하기 전까지 앱이 브로드캐스트나 런처에 노출되지 않습니다. Samsung One UI Watch는 이 상태를 런처 표시 여부에도 적용합니다. `adb install -r`(교체 설치)은 기존 앱이 있을 때만 stopped 상태를 유지하지 않으므로, 완전 언인스톨 후 재설치 시에는 항상 이 문제가 발생합니다.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

> AGENT

앱 목록 문제 해결됐습니다. 원인 정리:

**근본 원인**: 새 APK 설치 직후 Android가 앱을 `stopped=true` 상태로 시작 → Samsung 런처가 이 상태의 앱을 숨김

**해결 방법**: `adb shell am start`로 한 번 실행 → `stopped=false`로 전환 → 런처에 표시됨

**앞으로 ADB 설치 시 규칙:**
```bash
# ✅ 항상 이 방법 사용 (stopped 상태 유지 안 됨)
adb install -r app-debug.apk

# ❌ 이 방법은 stopped=true 발생
```

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
Android 아이콘 우선순위: `mipmap-anydpi-v26/*.xml` (adaptive icon, API 26+) > `mipmap-{density}/*.xml` > `mipmap-{density}/*.png`. Wear OS는 API 28+이므로 anydpi-v26 XML이 항상 PNG를 덮어씁니다. 두 XML을 제거하면 PNG가 적용됩니다.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

```json
}
```

```
470	  String _estimateBattery(int hibernation, int screenOff) {
471	    if (hibernation == 65535) return '약 80분';
472	    final total = hibernation + screenOff;
473	    if (total == 0) return '—';
474	    final dutyPct = hibernation * 100 / total;
475	    if (dutyPct >= 80) return '약 1.5시간';
476	    if (dutyPct >= 50) return '약 2시간';
477	    if (dutyPct >= 20) return '약 4시간';
478	    if (dutyPct >= 10) return '약 6시간';
479	    return '약 8시간+';
480	  }

511	  Future<void> _applyPreset(_ModePreset preset) async {
512	    final dataSource = ref.read(ilensDataSourceProvider);
513	    if (!dataSource.isConnected) {
514	      if (mounted) {
515	        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
516	          const SnackBar(content: Text('RunVision이 연결되지 않았습니다'), backgroundColor: Colors.orange),
517	        );
518	      }
519	      return;
520	    }
521	    try {
522	      await ref.read(ilensSettingsProvider.notifier).setHibernationTime(preset.hibernation);
523	      if (preset.screenOff > 0) {
524	        await ref.read(ilensSettingsProvider.notifier).setScreenOffTime(preset.screenOff);
525	      }
526	    } catch (e) {
527	      await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 200));
528	      if (mounted && ref.read(ilensConnectionStateProvider)) {
529	        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
530	          const SnackBar(content: Text('설정 전송 실패. 다시 시도해주세요'), backgroundColor: Colors.red),
531	        );
532	      }
533	    }
534	  }

536	  Future<void> _sendCustomSettings() async {
537	    final onTimeText = _onTimeController.text.trim();
538	    final cycleText = _cycleController.text.trim();
539	    if (onTimeText.isEmpty && cycleText.isEmpty) return;
540	
541	    final dataSource = ref.read(ilensDataSourceProvider);
542	    if (!dataSource.isConnected) {
543	      if (mounted) {
544	        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
545	          const SnackBar(content: Text('RunVision이 연결되지 않았습니다'), backgroundColor: Colors.orange),
546	        );
547	      }
548	      return;
549	    }
550	
551	    try {
552	      if (onTimeText.isNotEmpty) {
553	        final onTime = int.tryParse(onTimeText);
554	        if (onTime != null && onTime > 0) {
555	          await ref.read(ilensSettingsProvider.notifier).setHibernationTime(onTime);
556	        }
557	      }
558	      if (cycleText.isNotEmpty) {
559	        final cycle = int.tryParse(cycleText);
560	        if (cycle != null && cycle >= 0) {
561	          await ref.read(ilensSettingsProvider.notifier).setScreenOffTime(cycle);
562	        }
563	      }
564	      _onTimeController.clear();
565	      _cycleController.clear();
566	      if (mounted) FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
567	    } catch (e) {
568	      await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 200));
569	      if (mounted && ref.read(ilensConnectionStateProvider)) {
570	        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
```

```
470	  String _estimateBattery(int hibernation, int screenOff) {
471	    if (hibernation == 65535) return '약 80분';
472	    final total = hibernation + screenOff;
473	    if (total == 0) return '—';
474	    final dutyPct = hibernation * 100 / total;
475	    if (dutyPct >= 80) return '약 1.5시간';
476	    if (dutyPct >= 50) return '약 2시간';
477	    if (dutyPct >= 20) return '약 4시간';
478	    if (dutyPct >= 10) return '약 6시간';
479	    return '약 8시간+';
480	  }

511	  Future<void> _applyPreset(_ModePreset preset) async {
512	    final dataSource = ref.read(ilensDataSourceProvider);

517	        );
518	      }
519	      return;
520	    }
521	    try {
522	      await ref.read(ilensSettingsProvider.notifier).setHibernationTime(preset.hibernation);
523	      if (preset.screenOff > 0) {
524	        await ref.read(ilensSettingsProvider.notifier).setScreenOffTime(preset.screenOff);
525	      }

536	  Future<void> _sendCustomSettings() async {
537	    final onTimeText = _onTimeController.text.trim();
538	    final cycleText = _cycleController.text.trim();
539	    if (onTimeText.isEmpty && cycleText.isEmpty) return;
540	
541	    final dataSource = ref.read(ilensDataSourceProvider);
542	    if (!dataSource.isConnected) {
543	      if (mounted) {
544	        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(

549	    }
550	
551	    try {

555	          await ref.read(ilensSettingsProvider.notifier).setHibernationTime(onTime);
556	        }
557	      }

561	          await ref.read(ilensSettingsProvider.notifier).setScreenOffTime(cycle);
562	        }
563	      }
564	      _onTimeController.clear();
565	      _cycleController.clear();
566	      if (mounted) FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
567	    } catch (e) {

569	      if (mounted && ref.read(ilensConnectionStateProvider)) {

572	        );
```

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
The `_detectMode()` function is the critical bridge between BLE state and UI — it must match on exact protocol values. The old `screenOffTime: 60` (60초) vs new `3600` (60분) is easy to miss; keying on wrong values silently puts users into `custom` mode even after tapping a preset.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

> AGENT

Everything checks out. Here's a summary of all changes made:

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
The `isBrightnessAvailable` guard at line 493 matters: some rLens units don't expose the brightness characteristic (older firmware). Without the guard, `setBrightness()` would throw on those units and the screen mode would also fail to apply — brightness is sent first, so the entire preset would silently abort.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

---

**Changes applied to `ilens_settings_card.dart`:**

| What | Before | After |
|------|--------|-------|
| Enum | `half, full, short, custom` | `alwaysOn, race, custom` |
| Preset 1 | `단거리` hibernation=65535, screenOff=0, ~80분 | `항상켜짐` hibernation=65535, screenOff=0, brightness=10, ~1시간 30분 |
| Preset 2 | `하프코스` / `풀코스` | `대회모드` hibernation=5, screenOff=3600, brightness=10, ~4시간 30분 |
| Detection | screenOff==60 for full | screenOff==**3600** for race (60분) |
| On preset tap | hibernation + screenOff only | + `setBrightness(10)` (if brightness available) |
| 사용자설정 battery row | `_estimateBattery()` displayed | 제거됨 |
| 주의 문구 | 화면 밝기와 주변 기온... | 사용시간은 사용 워치와 주변 기온... |

| 프리셋 | hibernation | screenOff | brightness | 표시 사용시간 |

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
`_detectMode()`의 `screenOffTime == 3600` 조건이 핵심입니다. 이전 풀코스(60초)에서 대회모드(3600초)로 바뀌었기 때문에, 디바이스에 기존 설정(60초)이 남아있으면 custom 모드로 인식됩니다. 앱 처음 열 때 `readFromDevice()`가 실행되어 실제 디바이스 값을 읽어오므로, 기기에서 대회모드를 한 번 탭하면 이후부터 정상 인식됩니다.

5초 켜짐 / 60초 꺼짐 = duty cycle 약 7.7%. 이 비율이면 항상켜짐(~1.5시간) 대비 약 13배 절약이므로 ~4.5시간은 현실적인 수치입니다. 이전 `_estimateBattery()` 로직도 `dutyPct >= 10`이면 약 6시간으로 계산했는데, 실측 기준으로 4.5시간으로 보수적으로 잡은 것이 맞습니다.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

워치가 지금은 연결 안 되어 있습니다. 두 가지를 병렬로 진행하겠습니다. Flutter APK 빌드를 시작하면서 워치 연결 안내를 드립니다.

**가민 워치 연결 방법:**
1. FR265를 USB로 PC에 연결
2. 워치에서 "Mass Storage" 모드 선택
3. 연결되면 Windows 탐색기에서 새 드라이브 문자 확인 (예: E:, F:)
4. 연결 후 여기서 알려주시면 복사 명령 바로 실행하겠습니다

```
131	                    var paired = BluetoothLowEnergy.getPairedDevices();
132	                    var dev = paired.next() as BluetoothLowEnergy.Device;
133	                    while (dev != null) {
134	                        BluetoothLowEnergy.unpairDevice(dev);
135	                        dev = paired.next() as BluetoothLowEnergy.Device;
136	                    }
137	                } catch (ex2) {
138	                    // 무시
139	                }
140	            }
141	
142	            _scanStatus = "INIT_OK";
143	            addBleLog("READY");
144	        } catch (ex) {
145	            _scanStatus = "INIT_ERR";
146	            addBleLog("ERR:init");
147	        }
148	    }
149	
150	    //! Check for already paired devices (Passive Connection)
151	    //! iLens는 multi-bonding 미지원 → 항상 새로 스캔/페어링
152	    private function checkPairedDevices() as Void {
153	        try {
154	            // 기존 페어링 정보 삭제 (iLens가 다른 기기와 페어링되었을 수 있음)
155	            // FR55 호환성: has 연산자로 API 존재 여부 확인
156	            if (BluetoothLowEnergy has :getPairedDevices) {
157	                var pairedDevices = BluetoothLowEnergy.getPairedDevices();
158	                var device = pairedDevices.next() as BluetoothLowEnergy.Device;
159	                while (device != null) {
160	                    try {
161	                        BluetoothLowEnergy.unpairDevice(device);
162	                        addBleLog("UNPAIR");
163	                    } catch (ex) {
164	                        // 무시
165	                    }
166	                    device = pairedDevices.next() as BluetoothLowEnergy.Device;
167	                }
168	            }
169	
170	            // 항상 새로 스캔 (iLens는 multi-bonding 미지원)
171	            try {
172	                BluetoothLowEnergy.registerProfile(getExerciseProfile());
173	                BluetoothLowEnergy.setScanState(BluetoothLowEnergy.SCAN_STATE_SCANNING);
174	                _scanStatus = "SCANNING";
175	                addBleLog("SCAN");
176	            } catch (ex) {
177	                _scanStatus = "SCAN_ERR";
178	                addBleLog("ERR:scan");
179	            }
180	        } catch (ex) {
181	            _scanStatus = "ERR:init";
182	            addBleLog("ERR:init");
183	        }
184	    }

245	    //! Called when activity is reset
246	    function onTimerReset() as Void {
247	        // Reset statistics
248	        _totalSpeed = 0.0;
249	        _speedSamples = 0;
250	        _maxHeartRate = 0;
251	        _avgSpeedLabel = "---";
252	        _maxHrLabel = "---";
253	        _paceLabel = "--:--";
254	        _distanceLabel = "0.00";
255	        _timeLabel = "0:00";
256	        _speedLabel = "---";
257	        _hrLabel = "---";
258	        _cadenceLabel = "---";
259	        _devicesFound = 0;
260	        _elapsedSeconds = 0;  // ✅ 경과 시간 초기화
261	    }
262	
263	    //! Called each second to compute and display values (DataField)
264	    //! @param info Activity.Info object
265	    function compute(info as Activity.Info) as Void {
266	        // Passive Connection 타임아웃 (3초)
267	        if (_scanStatus.equals("PASSIVE") && !_isConnected && _elapsedSeconds >= 3) {
268	            try {
269	                // FR55 호환성: has 연산자로 API 존재 여부 확인
270	                if (_connectedDevice != null && (BluetoothLowEnergy has :unpairDevice)) {
271	                    BluetoothLowEnergy.unpairDevice(_connectedDevice);
272	                }
273	                _connectedDevice = null;
274	                _profileRegistered = false;
275	                BluetoothLowEnergy.registerProfile(getExerciseProfile());
276	                _scanStatus = "RESCAN";
277	                addBleLog("RESCAN");
278	            } catch (ex) {
279	                addBleLog("ERR:rescan");
280	            }
281	        }
282	
283	        // ✅ Pairing 타임아웃 (Connecting 상태 멈춤 방지)
284	        // System.getTimer() 사용 - 액티비티 시작 전에도 동작
285	        if (_pairingStartTime > 0 && !_isConnected) {
286	            var pairingDuration = System.getTimer() - _pairingStartTime;
287	            if (pairingDuration >= PAIRING_TIMEOUT_MS) {
288	                _pairingRetryCount++;
289	                addBleLog("PAIR_TO:" + _pairingRetryCount);  // Pairing Timeout + retry count
290	                _pairingStartTime = 0;
291	
292	                try {
293	                    if (_connectedDevice != null && (BluetoothLowEnergy has :unpairDevice)) {
294	                        BluetoothLowEnergy.unpairDevice(_connectedDevice);
295	                    }
296	                    _connectedDevice = null;
297	                    _isReconnecting = false;
298	                } catch (ex) {
299	                    // 무시
300	                }
301	
302	                if (_pairingRetryCount >= PAIRING_MAX_RETRIES) {
303	                    // 3회 실패 → CONN_ERR
304	                    _scanStatus = "CONN_ERR";
305	                    _pairingRetryCount = 0;
306	                    addBleLog("CONN_ERR");
307	                } else {
308	                    // 재시도: 즉시 다시 pairing
309	                    _scanStatus = "RETRY " + _pairingRetryCount;
310	                    if (_lastScanResult != null) {
311	                        try {
312	                            _pairingStartTime = System.getTimer();
313	                            _connectedDevice = BluetoothLowEnergy.pairDevice(_lastScanResult);
314	                            if (_connectedDevice == null) {
315	                                _pairingStartTime = 0;
316	                            }
317	                        } catch (ex) {
318	                            _pairingStartTime = 0;
319	                        }
320	                    }
321	                }
322	            }
323	        }
324	
325	        // 스캔 타임아웃: 2-retry + 새 기기 등록 모드
326	        // 저장된 기기 3s×2 미발견 → savedRLensName 삭제 후 any rLens 스캔 3s×2
327	        if ((_scanStatus.equals("SCANNING") || _scanStatus.equals("NEW_DEV")) && _scanStartTime > 0 && !_isConnected) {
328	            var scanElapsed = System.getTimer() - _scanStartTime;
329	            if (scanElapsed >= SCAN_TIMEOUT_MS_IQ) {
330	                _scanStartTime = 0;
331	                _savedDeviceScanAttempts++;
332	
333	                var savedDevice = Application.Storage.getValue("savedRLensName");
334	
335	                if (savedDevice != null && _savedDeviceScanAttempts >= 2) {
336	                    // 저장된 기기 2회 실패 → 새 기기 등록 모드
337	                    Application.Storage.deleteValue("savedRLensName");
338	                    _savedDeviceScanAttempts = 0;
339	                    _scanStartTime = System.getTimer();  // 새 타임아웃 윈도우
340	                    addBleLog("NEW_DEV");
341	                    _scanStatus = "NEW_DEV";
342	                } else if (savedDevice == null && _savedDeviceScanAttempts >= 2) {
343	                    // 새 기기 등록 모드 또는 최초 실행 2회 실패 → 에러
344	                    _scanStatus = "SCAN_FAIL";
345	                    _savedDeviceScanAttempts = 0;
346	                    addBleLog("SCAN_FAIL");
347	                } else {
348	                    // 1차 실패 → 재시도 (스캔 계속 유지)
349	                    _scanStartTime = System.getTimer();
350	                    addBleLog("SCAN_TO:" + _savedDeviceScanAttempts);
351	                }
352	
353	                WatchUi.requestUpdate();
354	            }
355	        }
356	
357	        // Auto-reconnect (연결 끊김 시)
358	        // 전략: 1-5회는 5초 간격 단순 재연결, 6회째 unpair 후 재스캔, 이후 1분마다 재스캔
359	        if (_needsReconnect && !_isConnected && !_isReconnecting) {
360	            var timeSinceLastTry = _elapsedSeconds - _lastReconnectTime;
361	            var shouldTry = false;
362	            var interval = 0;
363	
364	            if (_reconnectAttempts < RECONNECT_FAST_MAX) {
365	                // 1-5회: 5초 간격
366	                interval = RECONNECT_FAST_INTERVAL;
367	                shouldTry = (timeSinceLastTry >= interval);
368	            } else {
369	                // 6회 이후: 1분 간격
370	                interval = RECONNECT_SLOW_INTERVAL;
371	                shouldTry = (timeSinceLastTry >= interval);
372	            }
373	
374	            if (shouldTry) {
375	                _reconnectAttempts++;
376	                _lastReconnectTime = _elapsedSeconds;
377	                _isReconnecting = true;
378	
379	                if (_reconnectAttempts <= RECONNECT_FAST_MAX && _lastScanResult != null) {
380	                    // 1-5회: 단순 재연결 시도 (빠름)
381	                    addBleLog("RE:" + _reconnectAttempts);
382	                    _scanStatus = "RECONN " + _reconnectAttempts;
383	                    try {
384	                        _pairingStartTime = System.getTimer();  // ✅ 타임아웃 추적 시작
385	                        _connectedDevice = BluetoothLowEnergy.pairDevice(_lastScanResult);
386	                        if (_connectedDevice == null) {
387	                            _isReconnecting = false;
388	                            _pairingStartTime = 0;  // 실패 시 리셋
389	                        }
390	                    } catch (ex) {
391	                        _isReconnecting = false;
392	                        _pairingStartTime = 0;  // 실패 시 리셋
393	                    }
394	                } else {
395	                    // 6회 이후: unpair 후 새로 스캔
396	                    addBleLog("RESCAN:" + _reconnectAttempts);
397	                    _scanStatus = "RESCAN";
398	                    try {
399	                        // 기존 bonding 삭제 (FR55 호환성: has 연산자로 확인)
400	                        if (BluetoothLowEnergy has :getPairedDevices) {
401	                            var paired = BluetoothLowEnergy.getPairedDevices();
402	                            var dev = paired.next() as BluetoothLowEnergy.Device;
403	                            while (dev != null) {
404	                                BluetoothLowEnergy.unpairDevice(dev);
405	                                dev = paired.next() as BluetoothLowEnergy.Device;
406	                            }
407	                        }
408	                        // 새로 스캔 시작
409	                        BluetoothLowEnergy.setScanState(BluetoothLowEnergy.SCAN_STATE_SCANNING);
410	                        _isReconnecting = false;
411	                    } catch (ex) {
412	                        _isReconnecting = false;
413	                    }
414	                }
415	            }
416	        }
417	
418	        // ✅ Lazy Loading: Characteristic 필요할 때 획득 (매초 1회 시도)
419	        if (_isConnected && _connectedDevice != null && _exerciseCharacteristic == null) {
420	            try {
421	                _exerciseCharacteristic = tryGetServiceCharacteristic(
422	                    ILensProtocol.EXERCISE_SERVICE_UUID,
423	                    ILensProtocol.EXERCISE_DATA_UUID,
424	                    3  // 3번 동기 재시도
425	                );
426	                _charRetryCount = 0;  // 성공 시 리셋
427	                addBleLog("CHAR OK");
428	                _scanStatus = "READY";
429	            } catch (ex) {
430	                _charRetryCount++;
431	                if (_charRetryCount >= 5) {
432	                    // 5회 실패 → 재연결 트리거
433	                    _charRetryCount = 0;
434	                    _isConnected = false;
435	                    _connectedDevice = null;
436	                    _scanStatus = "RECONN...";
437	                    addBleLog("RECONN");
438	                    // → auto-reconnect 로직이 다음 compute에서 동작
439	                } else {
440	                    // 실패 횟수 표시 (1~4) - 사용자가 이상 상태 인지 가능
441	                    _scanStatus = "CHAR_FAIL(" + _charRetryCount + ")";
442	                }
443	            }
444	        }
445	
446	        // ========== 데이터 수집 (라벨 업데이트) ==========
447	        // ActiveLook 패턴: has 체크 + false 체크
448	
449	        // Get current speed (m/s -> km/h)
450	        var speedMs = info != null && info has :currentSpeed ? info.currentSpeed : null;
451	        var speedKmh = 0;
452	        var paceSeconds = 0;  // ← Pace를 초 단위로 저장 (iLens 전송용)
453	        var speedValid = speedMs != null && speedMs > 0;
454	
455	        if (speedValid) {
456	            speedKmh = ((speedMs * 3.6) + 0.5).toNumber();  // ✅ 반올림
457	            _speedLabel = speedKmh.format("%d");
458	
459	            // Calculate pace (min/km) - 러너들은 Pace에 익숙
460	            var paceMinPerKm = 60.0 / (speedMs * 3.6);
461	            var paceMin = paceMinPerKm.toNumber();
462	            var paceSec = ((paceMinPerKm - paceMin) * 60).toNumber();
463	            _paceLabel = paceMin.format("%d") + ":" + paceSec.format("%02d");
464	
465	            // iLens 전송용: Pace를 총 초로 변환 (예: 4:25 → 265초)
466	            // iLens 펌웨어가 60으로 나눠서 표시: 265 / 60 = 4.42
467	            paceSeconds = paceMin * 60 + paceSec;
468	
469	            // Update average speed
470	            _totalSpeed += speedMs * 3.6;
471	            _speedSamples++;
472	            var avgSpeed = (_totalSpeed / _speedSamples).toNumber();
473	            _avgSpeedLabel = avgSpeed.format("%d");
474	        } else {
475	            _speedLabel = "0";
476	            _paceLabel = "--:--";
477	        }
478	
479	        // Get current heart rate (ActiveLook 패턴)
480	        var hr = info != null && info has :currentHeartRate ? info.currentHeartRate : null;
481	        var hrValid = hr != null && hr > 0;
482	        if (hrValid) {
483	            _hrLabel = hr.format("%d");
484	
485	            // Track max heart rate
486	            if (hr > _maxHeartRate) {
487	                _maxHeartRate = hr;
488	                _maxHrLabel = hr.format("%d");
489	            }
490	        } else {
491	            _hrLabel = "---";
492	            hr = 0;
493	        }
494	
495	        // Get current cadence (ActiveLook 패턴)
496	        var cadence = info != null && info has :currentCadence ? info.currentCadence : null;
497	        var cadenceValid = cadence != null && cadence > 0;
498	        if (cadenceValid) {
499	            _cadenceLabel = cadence.format("%d");
500	        } else {
501	            _cadenceLabel = "---";
502	            cadence = 0;
503	        }
504	
505	        // Get elapsed distance (meters) - Running Power 계산에 필요
506	        var distance = info != null && info has :elapsedDistance ? info.elapsedDistance : null;
507	        var distanceValid = distance != null && distance > 0;
508	        if (distanceValid) {
509	            var distanceKm = distance / 1000.0;
510	            _distanceLabel = distanceKm.format("%.2f");
511	        } else {
512	            _distanceLabel = "0.00";
513	            distance = 0;
514	        }
515	
516	        // ========== Running Power 계산 ==========
517	        // Power Meter 대신 GPS 데이터로 Running Power 추정
518	        // Formula: Power = Weight × Speed × (1 + |Grade|/100) × k
519	        //   - Weight: 체중 (kg)
520	        //   - Speed: 속도 (m/s)
521	        //   - Grade: 경사도 (%)
522	        //   - k: 보정 상수 (≈1.8, Garmin/Stryd 기준)
523	
524	        var power = 0;
525	
526	        // 1. UserProfile에서 체중 가져오기 (처음 한 번만)
527	        if (!_weightInitialized) {
528	            try {
529	                var profile = UserProfile.getProfile();
530	                if (profile != null && profile has :weight) {
531	                    var profileWeight = profile.weight;  // grams
532	                    if (profileWeight != null && profileWeight > 0) {
533	                        _userWeight = profileWeight / 1000.0;  // g → kg
534	                        // DFLogger.log("[POWER] User weight: " + _userWeight.format("%.1f") + " kg");
535	                    }
536	                }
537	            } catch (ex) {
538	                // DFLogger.logError("POWER", "Failed to get user weight");
539	            }
540	            _weightInitialized = true;
541	        }
542	
543	        // 2. 고도 가져오기
544	        var altitude = info != null && info has :altitude ? info.altitude : null;
545	
546	        // 3. Running Power 계산 (속도와 거리가 유효할 때만)
547	        if (speedValid && distanceValid && altitude != null) {
548	            // 경사도 계산 (최근 구간의 고도 변화)
549	            var grade = 0.0;
550	            var distanceDelta = distance - _previousDistance;
551	
552	            if (distanceDelta > 10.0) {  // 10m 이상 이동했을 때만 경사도 계산
553	                var altitudeDelta = altitude - _previousAltitude;
554	                grade = (altitudeDelta / distanceDelta) * 100.0;  // % 단위
555	
556	                // 경사도 범위 제한 (-30% ~ +30%)
557	                if (grade < -30.0) { grade = -30.0; }
558	                if (grade > 30.0) { grade = 30.0; }
559	
560	                // 다음 계산을 위해 저장
561	                _previousAltitude = altitude;
562	                _previousDistance = distance;
563	            }
564	
565	            // Running Power 계산
566	            // Power = Weight × Speed × (1 + |Grade|/100) × 1.8
567	            var gradeFactor = 1.0 + (grade > 0 ? grade : -grade) / 100.0;  // |Grade|/100
568	            power = (_userWeight * speedMs * gradeFactor * 1.8).toNumber();
569	
570	            // 파워 범위 제한 (0-999 watts, 일반 러너 범위)
571	            if (power < 0) { power = 0; }
572	            if (power > 999) { power = 999; }
573	        }
574	
575	        // ✅ Activity.Info에서 실제 경과 시간 사용 (timerTime = milliseconds)
576	        // compute()는 1초마다 호출되지 않을 수 있으므로 timerTime 사용이 정확함
577	        if (info != null && info has :timerTime && info.timerTime != null) {
578	            _elapsedSeconds = (info.timerTime / 1000).toNumber();  // ms → seconds
579	        } else {
580	            // Fallback: 수동 카운터 (timerTime 미지원 기기)
581	            _elapsedSeconds += 1;
582	        }
583	        var minutes = _elapsedSeconds / 60;
584	        var secs = _elapsedSeconds % 60;
585	        _timeLabel = minutes.format("%d") + ":" + secs.format("%02d");
586	
587	        // ========== iLens 전송: Queue 방식 (Flutter와 동일) ==========
588	        // 5초마다 모든 메트릭을 queue에 추가 → 순차 전송
589	        // iLens는 WRITE_WITH_RESPONSE만 지원 → onCharacteristicWrite() callback에서 다음 패킷 전송
590	        _computeCount++;
591	        if (_isConnected && _exerciseCharacteristic != null && _computeCount % 5 == 0) {
592	            try {
593	                // 1. Write 진행 중이 아닐 때만 queue 초기화
594	                if (!_isWriting) {
595	                    _writeQueue = [] as Lang.Array<Lang.ByteArray>;
596	
597	                    // Queue에 5개 메트릭 추가 (v1.0.2: Sport Time 사용, Power/Current Time 제거)
598	                    _writeQueue.add(ILensProtocol.createExerciseTimePacket(_elapsedSeconds));  // ⭐ Sport Time (0x03)
599	                    _writeQueue.add(ILensProtocol.createVelocityPacket(paceSeconds));          // Pace
600	                    _writeQueue.add(ILensProtocol.createHeartRatePacket(hr));                  // Heart Rate
601	                    _writeQueue.add(ILensProtocol.createCadencePacket(cadence));              // Cadence
602	                    _writeQueue.add(ILensProtocol.createDistancePacket(distance != null ? distance : 0));  // Distance
603	
604	                    // DFLogger.log("[TX] pace=" + paceSeconds + " hr=" + hr + " cad=" + cadence + " pwr=" + power);
605	
606	                    // 화면에 핵심 메트릭만 표시
607	                    addTxLog("P:" + _paceLabel + " T:" + _timeLabel);
608	
609	                    processWriteQueue();
610	                }
611	            } catch (ex) {
612	                addTxLog("q:err");
613	                // DFLogger.logError("QUEUE", "Queue error");
614	            }
615	        }
616	    }
617	
618	    //! Draw the data field
619	    //! @param dc Device context
620	    function onUpdate(dc as Graphics.Dc) as Void {
621	        // Set background color
622	        dc.setColor(Graphics.COLOR_TRANSPARENT, Graphics.COLOR_BLACK);
623	        dc.clear();
624	
625	        dc.setColor(Graphics.COLOR_WHITE, Graphics.COLOR_TRANSPARENT);
626	
627	        try {
628	            var width = dc.getWidth();
629	            var height = dc.getHeight();
630	            var centerX = width / 2;
631	            var centerY = height / 2;
632	
633	            // 로고 표시 (중앙, 176x37)
634	            var logo = WatchUi.loadResource(Rez.Drawables.RunVisionLogo);
635	            dc.drawBitmap(centerX - 88, centerY - 40, logo);
636	
637	            // 상태 텍스트 (로고 아래)

660	    //! Called when characteristic write completes (WRITE_WITH_RESPONSE)
661	    function onCharacteristicWrite(characteristic as BluetoothLowEnergy.Characteristic, status as BluetoothLowEnergy.Status) as Void {
662	        _isWriting = false;
663	
664	        if (status != BluetoothLowEnergy.STATUS_SUCCESS) {
665	            addTxLog("ERR:wr");
666	            _scanStatus = "WRITE_ERR";
667	            _writeQueue = [] as Lang.Array<Lang.ByteArray>;
668	            return;
669	        }
670	
671	        // 속도 감지 (첫 Write 콜백 시)
672	        if (!_speedDetected && _writeStartTime > 0) {
673	            var elapsed = System.getTimer() - _writeStartTime;
674	            _speedDetected = true;
675	            _writeStartTime = 0;
676	
677	            if (elapsed > SLOW_DEVICE_THRESHOLD_MS) {
678	                // 느린 기기 → DEFAULT 모드로 전환
679	                _useDefaultWrite = true;
680	                addBleLog("MODE:DEFAULT");
681	            } else {
682	                // 빠른 기기 → WITH_RESPONSE 유지
683	                addBleLog("MODE:RESPONSE");
684	            }
685	        }
686	
687	        // 다음 패킷 전송
688	        processWriteQueue();
689	    }

691	    //! Process write queue (순차 전송)
692	    private function processWriteQueue() as Void {
693	        if (_isWriting) { return; }
694	        if (_writeQueue.size() == 0) { return; }
695	
696	        var packet = _writeQueue[0];
697	        _writeQueue = _writeQueue.slice(1, null) as Lang.Array<Lang.ByteArray>;
698	
699	        _isWriting = true;
700	        sendToILens(packet);
701	    }

747	    //! Try and retry to get a characteristic from a service (ActiveLook 패턴 완전 복제)
748	    //! @param serviceUuid Service UUID
749	    //! @param characteristicUuid Characteristic UUID
750	    //! @param nbRetry Number of retries (권장: 5)
751	    //! @return Characteristic
752	    //! @throws InvalidValueException if not found after retries
753	    private function tryGetServiceCharacteristic(
754	        serviceUuid as BluetoothLowEnergy.Uuid,
755	        characteristicUuid as BluetoothLowEnergy.Uuid,
756	        nbRetry as Lang.Number
757	    ) as BluetoothLowEnergy.Characteristic {
758	        if (_connectedDevice == null) {
759	            throw new Lang.InvalidValueException("(E) Not connected");
760	        }
761	
762	        var dev = _connectedDevice as BluetoothLowEnergy.Device;
763	        var service = dev.getService(serviceUuid);
764	
765	        // ✅ RETRY PATTERN: nbRetry번 재시도 (ActiveLook 방식)
766	        for (var i = 0; i < nbRetry; i++) {
767	            if (service == null) {
768	                service = dev.getService(serviceUuid);  // ← Service 재시도
769	                if (service == null) {
770	                    System.println("[RETRY " + i + "] Service still null");
771	                } else {
772	                    System.println("[RETRY " + i + "] Service found!");
773	                }
774	            } else {
775	                var characteristic = service.getCharacteristic(characteristicUuid);
776	                if (characteristic != null) {
777	                    // ✅ 성공 시 즉시 리턴
778	                    System.println("tryGetServiceCharacteristic: success at retry " + i);
779	                    return characteristic;
780	                } else {
781	                    System.println("[RETRY " + i + "] Service OK but Char null");
782	                }
783	            }
784	        }
785	
786	        // ✅ nbRetry번 실패 시 예외 발생
787	        if (service == null) {
788	            System.println("FINAL: Service is NULL");
789	            throw new Lang.InvalidValueException(
790	                "(E) Could not get service after " + nbRetry + " retries"
791	            );
792	        }
793	        System.println("FINAL: Service OK but Characteristic is NULL");
794	        throw new Lang.InvalidValueException(
795	            "(E) Could not get characteristic after " + nbRetry + " retries"
796	        );
797	    }

799	    //! Send data to iLens (WRITE_WITH_RESPONSE only)
800	    //! Send data to iLens with auto-detected Write Type
801	    //! - 빠른 기기: WRITE_WITH_RESPONSE (안정적, ~80ms)
802	    //! - 느린 기기: WRITE_TYPE_DEFAULT (빠름, FR55용)
803	    private function sendToILens(packet as Lang.ByteArray) as Void {
804	        if (_exerciseCharacteristic == null) {
805	            _isWriting = false;
806	            return;
807	        }
808	
809	        try {
810	            // 속도 측정 시작 (첫 Write 시)
811	            if (!_speedDetected && _writeStartTime == 0) {
812	                _writeStartTime = System.getTimer();
813	            }
814	
815	            // Write Type 선택
816	            var writeType = BluetoothLowEnergy.WRITE_TYPE_WITH_RESPONSE;
817	            if (_useDefaultWrite) {
818	                writeType = BluetoothLowEnergy.WRITE_TYPE_DEFAULT;
819	            }
820	
821	            _exerciseCharacteristic.requestWrite(packet, {:writeType => writeType});
822	        } catch (ex) {
823	            addTxLog("ERR:tx");
824	            _isWriting = false;
825	        }
826	    }

857	    //! Called when rLens device is found during scanning
858	    function onScanResult(scanResult as BluetoothLowEnergy.ScanResult) as Void {
859	        addBleLog("FOUND");
860	        System.println("iLens found, RSSI=" + scanResult.getRssi());
861	
862	        // Save device name on first connection (device name = serial number)
863	        if (Application.Storage.getValue("savedRLensName") == null) {
864	            var raw = scanResult.getRawData();
865	            if (raw != null) {
866	                var rawStr = "";
867	                for (var i = 0; i < raw.size(); i++) {
868	                    var c = raw[i];
869	                    if (c >= 0x20 && c <= 0x7E) { rawStr += c.toChar(); }
870	                }
871	                // Extract device name: find "rlens" and read until whitespace
872	                var lowerStr = rawStr.toLower();
873	                var idx = lowerStr.find("rlens");
874	                if (idx != -1) {
875	                    var nameEnd = idx;
876	                    while (nameEnd < rawStr.length()) {
877	                        var ch = rawStr.substring(nameEnd, nameEnd + 1);
878	                        if (ch.equals(" ")) { break; }
879	                        nameEnd++;
880	                    }
881	                    var deviceName = rawStr.substring(idx, nameEnd);
882	                    Application.Storage.setValue("savedRLensName", deviceName);
883	                    System.println("Saved rLens device: " + deviceName);
884	                }
885	            }
886	        }
887	
888	        // Auto-connect
889	        if (!_isConnected && _connectedDevice == null) {
890	            _devicesFound++;
891	            _lastScanResult = scanResult;
892	
893	            BluetoothLowEnergy.setScanState(BluetoothLowEnergy.SCAN_STATE_OFF);
894	
895	            addBleLog("PAIRING");
896	            _pairingStartTime = System.getTimer();  // ✅ 타임아웃 추적 시작
897	            _connectedDevice = BluetoothLowEnergy.pairDevice(scanResult);
898	
899	            if (_connectedDevice == null) {
900	                _scanStatus = "PAIR_FAIL";
901	                _pairingStartTime = 0;  // 실패 시 리셋
902	            } else {
903	                _scanStatus = "PAIRING";
904	            }
905	        }
906	
907	        WatchUi.requestUpdate();
908	    }

943	//! BLE Delegate - 별도 클래스 (DataField는 다중 상속 불가)
944	class RunVisionBleDelegate extends BluetoothLowEnergy.BleDelegate {
945	    private var _view;
946	
947	    function initialize(view) {
948	        BleDelegate.initialize();
949	        _view = view;
950	        // System.println("RunVisionBleDelegate initialized");
951	    }
952	
953	    //! rLens 기기 식별: 이름 전체 매칭 (기기명=시리얼번호, e.g. "rlens-e70b4")
954	    //! 저장된 기기명이 있으면 해당 기기만 연결 (다른 사람 기기 연결 방지)
955	    function onScanResults(results as BluetoothLowEnergy.Iterator) as Void {
956	        var savedDevice = Application.Storage.getValue("savedRLensName");
957	        var r = results.next() as BluetoothLowEnergy.ScanResult;
958	        while (r != null) {
959	            var raw = r.getRawData();
960	
961	            if (raw != null) {
962	                // Raw data 전체를 소문자 문자열로 변환
963	                var rawStr = "";
964	                for (var i = 0; i < raw.size(); i++) {
965	                    var c = raw[i];
966	                    if (c >= 0x20 && c <= 0x7E) {
967	                        rawStr += c.toChar();
968	                    }
969	                }
970	
971	                var lowerStr = rawStr.toLower();
972	                if (lowerStr.find("rlens") != -1) {
973	                    if (savedDevice != null) {
974	                        // 저장된 기기명과 정확히 일치하는 경우만 연결
975	                        if (rawStr.find(savedDevice) != -1) {
976	                            _view.onScanResult(r);
977	                            return;
978	                        }
979	                        // 불일치: 다른 사람의 rLens, 스킵
980	                    } else {
981	                        // 최초 실행: 처음 발견된 rLens에 연결
982	                        _view.onScanResult(r);
983	                        return;
984	                    }
985	                }
986	            }
987	
988	            r = results.next() as BluetoothLowEnergy.ScanResult;
989	        }
990	    }
```

`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

---

**결론**: 이번 scan retry 코드 변경 (`RunVisionIQView.mc`)은 변수/로직만 추가했고, 아이콘·리소스·manifest는 전혀 건드리지 않았습니다.

> AGENT

Found the crash. The scan timeout block at lines 325-355 is NOT wrapped in `try/catch`, unlike every other risky operation in `compute()`. When `Application.Storage.deleteValue()` throws — which happens on devices where the API isn't available — the DataField crashes with no recovery.

`deleteValue` was introduced in Connect IQ 2.2.0. The `has` guard check is also needed because `Application.Storage` is a module (same pattern used for `BluetoothLowEnergy has :unpairDevice`).

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
**Garmin Connect IQ exception behavior**: Any uncaught exception inside `compute()` kills the DataField process and shows the "broken IQ" icon. Unlike Dart/Flutter which has isolate crash recovery, Monkey C DataFields have zero crash recovery — one uncaught exception and it's dead.

**`Application.Storage` module guards**: Same pattern as `BluetoothLowEnergy has :unpairDevice` already used in this file. Module-level `has` checks work in Monkey C for both instance methods and static module methods.

**Safe fallback for `deleteValue`**: Setting the value to `null` via `setValue(key, null)` makes `getValue` return `null` — same logical effect as deletion, with 100% API compatibility.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

> AGENT

Committed. The `.prg` at `bin/RunVisionIQ.prg` is ready to install on the watch.

**Summary of the crash root cause and fix:**

The scan retry code added last session called `Application.Storage.deleteValue("savedRLensName")` inside `compute()` with no `try/catch`. On Garmin watches, any uncaught exception in `compute()` kills the DataField process and shows the broken IQ icon. The fix:

1. **Wrapped the entire scan timeout block in `try/catch`** — matches the pattern used everywhere else in `compute()` (pairing timeout, reconnect logic, etc.)
2. **Added `has :deleteValue` guard** — falls back to `setValue(key, null)` on older firmware where `deleteValue` doesn't exist. Functionally equivalent since `getValue` returns `null` in both cases.

The new `.prg` (13:15) is at `/home/jhkim/00.Projects/00.RunVision/runvision-iq/bin/RunVisionIQ.prg`. Copy it to the watch's `GARMIN/APPS/` folder via USB to install.

```
# Codex Adversarial Review

Target: working tree diff
Verdict: needs-attention

No-ship. The diff does not address the BLE write-failure path; it adds new ways to trigger it and still permits invalid device settings to be sent.

Findings:
- [high] Preset mode now issues multiple back-to-back GATT writes with no pacing or serialization (runvision/lib/features/ilens/presentation/widgets/ilens_settings_card.dart:492-499)
  `_applyPreset()` sends brightness, hibernation, and screen-off writes sequentially in one tap. The existing BLE codebase already documents that write timing/order is fragile and that settings writes can fail with `GATT_ERROR` if initialization/write sequencing is wrong. This change adds a higher-frequency failure path without any guard such as a write queue, inter-write delay, or read-back confirmation. Under real use, one preset tap can now fail partway through, leaving the device in a partially updated state while the UI only shows a generic retry message.
  Recommendation: Serialize settings writes through one BLE write pipeline in the datasource/notifier, add the same pacing discipline used elsewhere for fragile BLE operations, and make preset application atomic from the UI perspective (either all settings applied or the state is rolled back/refreshed from device).
- [high] Custom screen-off input now accepts protocol-invalid values, including `0` (runvision/lib/features/ilens/presentation/widgets/ilens_settings_card.dart:532-535)
  The new custom path allows any `cycle >= 0` and forwards it directly to `setScreenOffTime()`. The datasource comments define valid values as `10-900` or `65535` for touch mode. Sending `0` or other out-of-range values is therefore an explicit new invalid-input path introduced by this diff. At best this is rejected by the device; at worst it reproduces the same write error the user reports and makes recovery harder because the UI suppresses the actual cause.
  Recommendation: Validate custom input before sending: only allow the protocol’s supported range, map any special mode to the correct sentinel (`65535` if needed), and reject invalid values in both the UI and datasource so bad writes cannot reach BLE.

Next steps:
- Add strict validation for hibernation/screen-off values in the widget and in `ILensBleDataSource.setScreenOffTime()`.
- Move preset application to a single serialized BLE settings operation with inter-write pacing and explicit failure handling.
- Re-test the exact user repro after these guards are in place; this diff does not yet prove the original error path is fixed.
```

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
**BLE GATT write pacing**: `readFromDevice()`는 이미 각 BLE read 사이에 300ms 딜레이를 넣습니다. Write도 동일하게 처리해야 합니다 — 기기의 GATT 스택이 직전 응답을 처리하기 전에 다음 write가 들어오면 `GATT_ERROR`가 발생합니다.

**`cycle >= 0` 버그**: `0`을 허용하면 10바이트 `[0x00 * 10]`이 기기로 전송됩니다. 프로토콜상 정의되지 않은 값 — 기기가 이상 동작하거나 GATT_ERROR로 응답할 수 있습니다.

**`_applyPreset()` — 프리셋 탭 시 BLE write 순서**

```
153	        try {
154	            // 기존 페어링 정보 삭제 (iLens가 다른 기기와 페어링되었을 수 있음)

173	                BluetoothLowEnergy.setScanState(BluetoothLowEnergy.SCAN_STATE_SCANNING);

182	            addBleLog("ERR:init");
183	        }
```

```
757	    //! Try and retry to get a characteristic from a service (ActiveLook 패턴 완전 복제)
758	    //! @param serviceUuid Service UUID

760	    //! @param nbRetry Number of retries (권장: 5)
761	    //! @return Characteristic
762	    //! @throws InvalidValueException if not found after retries
763	    private function tryGetServiceCharacteristic(
764	        serviceUuid as BluetoothLowEnergy.Uuid,
765	        characteristicUuid as BluetoothLowEnergy.Uuid,
766	        nbRetry as Lang.Number
767	    ) as BluetoothLowEnergy.Characteristic {
768	        if (_connectedDevice == null) {
769	            throw new Lang.InvalidValueException("(E) Not connected");
770	        }
771	
772	        var dev = _connectedDevice as BluetoothLowEnergy.Device;
773	        var service = dev.getService(serviceUuid);
774	
775	        // ✅ RETRY PATTERN: nbRetry번 재시도 (ActiveLook 방식)
776	        for (var i = 0; i < nbRetry; i++) {
777	            if (service == null) {
778	                service = dev.getService(serviceUuid);  // ← Service 재시도
779	                if (service == null) {
780	                    System.println("[RETRY " + i + "] Service still null");
781	                } else {
782	                    System.println("[RETRY " + i + "] Service found!");
783	                }
784	            } else {
785	                var characteristic = service.getCharacteristic(characteristicUuid);
786	                if (characteristic != null) {
787	                    // ✅ 성공 시 즉시 리턴
788	                    System.println("tryGetServiceCharacteristic: success at retry " + i);
789	                    return characteristic;
790	                } else {
791	                    System.println("[RETRY " + i + "] Service OK but Char null");
792	                }
793	            }
794	        }
795	
796	        // ✅ nbRetry번 실패 시 예외 발생
797	        if (service == null) {
798	            System.println("FINAL: Service is NULL");
799	            throw new Lang.InvalidValueException(
800	                "(E) Could not get service after " + nbRetry + " retries"
801	            );
802	        }
803	        System.println("FINAL: Service OK but Characteristic is NULL");
804	        throw new Lang.InvalidValueException(
805	            "(E) Could not get characteristic after " + nbRetry + " retries"
806	        );
807	    }
```

```
757	    //! Try and retry to get a characteristic from a service (ActiveLook 패턴 완전 복제)
758	    //! @param serviceUuid Service UUID
759	    //! @param characteristicUuid Characteristic UUID
760	    //! @param nbRetry Number of retries (권장: 5)
761	    //! @return Characteristic
762	    //! @throws InvalidValueException if not found after retries
763	    private function tryGetServiceCharacteristic(
764	        serviceUuid as BluetoothLowEnergy.Uuid,
765	        characteristicUuid as BluetoothLowEnergy.Uuid,
766	        nbRetry as Lang.Number
767	    ) as BluetoothLowEnergy.Characteristic {
768	        if (_connectedDevice == null) {
769	            throw new Lang.InvalidValueException("(E) Not connected");
770	        }
771	
772	        var dev = _connectedDevice as BluetoothLowEnergy.Device;
773	        var service = dev.getService(serviceUuid);
774	
775	        // ✅ RETRY PATTERN: nbRetry번 재시도 (ActiveLook 방식)
776	        for (var i = 0; i < nbRetry; i++) {
777	            if (service == null) {
778	                service = dev.getService(serviceUuid);  // ← Service 재시도
779	                if (service == null) {
780	                    System.println("[RETRY " + i + "] Service still null");
781	                } else {
782	                    System.println("[RETRY " + i + "] Service found!");
783	                }
784	            } else {
785	                var characteristic = service.getCharacteristic(characteristicUuid);
786	                if (characteristic != null) {
787	                    // ✅ 성공 시 즉시 리턴
788	                    System.println("tryGetServiceCharacteristic: success at retry " + i);
789	                    return characteristic;
790	                } else {
791	                    System.println("[RETRY " + i + "] Service OK but Char null");
792	                }
793	            }
794	        }
795	
796	        // ✅ nbRetry번 실패 시 예외 발생
797	        if (service == null) {
798	            System.println("FINAL: Service is NULL");
799	            throw new Lang.InvalidValueException(
800	                "(E) Could not get service after " + nbRetry + " retries"
801	            );
802	        }
803	        System.println("FINAL: Service OK but Characteristic is NULL");
804	        throw new Lang.InvalidValueException(
805	            "(E) Could not get characteristic after " + nbRetry + " retries"
806	        );
807	    }
```

> AGENT

I've spotted the root cause. In Monkey C, `String.find()` returns `null` when not found — NOT `-1`. Both `onScanResults()` and `onScanResult()` use `!= -1` comparisons, so `null != -1` is **always true**, meaning every BLE device passes the "rlens" filter. Then when a non-rLens device tries to extract the device name, `idx` is `null`, and `while (nameEnd < rawStr.length())` crashes with a TypeError.

Let me check `onConnectedStateChanged()` too:

> AGENT

Three bugs to fix:
1. `onUpdate()` — draw ops outside try, broken catch, no log display
2. `onScanResult()` — no try/catch + `find() != -1` (should be `!= null`)  
3. `onScanResults()` — no try/catch + same `!= -1` bug

The `find() != -1` bug is the **root crash cause**: Monkey C's `String.find()` returns `null` when not found, so `null != -1` is always `true`, letting non-rLens devices through the filter. Then `idx = null` gets used as a number in the `while` loop → TypeError → DataField crash.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
Monkey C differs from most languages here: `String.find()` uses `null` (not `-1`) as the "not found" sentinel. Using `!= -1` is a silent logic error — it evaluates to `true` for BOTH found and not-found cases, making the filter useless. This pattern is a common pitfall when porting code from Java/Dart to Monkey C.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

> AGENT

Build complete — `RunVisionIQ.prg` updated at **14:40**.

---

**What was fixed:**

The root cause of the broken IQ icon was in `onScanResults()` and `onScanResult()`. Monkey C's `String.find()` returns `null` (not `-1`) when nothing is found. The code used `!= -1`, which in Monkey C evaluates to `true` for *both* found and not-found cases — so every BLE device in range passed the "rlens" name filter. When a non-rLens device slipped through, `idx` was `null`, and `while (nameEnd < rawStr.length())` tried to compare `null < Number` → TypeError → DataField process crash → broken IQ icon.

Three changes applied:
1. **`onScanResults()`** — `find() != -1` → `find() != null`, wrapped in try/catch
2. **`onScanResult()`** — same `find()` fix, wrapped in try/catch
3. **`onUpdate()`** — moved all drawing inside try/catch, hardened catch to not call `dc.getWidth()`, added `_bleDebugLogs` display so future issues show up as readable text instead of a mystery crash

Please install the 14:40 build on your watch. If you still see the broken IQ icon after this, the debug log lines on screen will tell us exactly where it fails.

```
"text":"# Codex Adversarial Review\n\nTarget: working tree diff\nVerdict: needs-attention\n\nNo-ship. The diff does not address the BLE write-failure path; it adds new ways to trigger it and still permits invalid device settings to be sent.\n\nFindings:\n- [high] Preset mode now issues multiple back-to-back GATT writes with no pacing or serialization (runvision/lib/features/ilens/presentation/widgets/ilens_settings_card.dart:492-499)\n  `_applyPreset()` sends brightness, hibernation, and screen-off writes sequentially in one tap. The existing BLE codebase already documents that write timing/order is fragile and that settings writes can fail with `GATT_ERROR` if initialization/write sequencing is wrong. This change adds a higher-frequency failure path without any guard such as a write queue, inter-write delay, or read-back confirmation. Under real use, one preset tap can now fail partway through, leaving the device in a partially updated state while the UI only shows a generic retry message.\n  Recommendation: Serialize settings writes through one BLE write pipeline in the datasource/notifier, add the same pacing discipline used elsewhere for fragile BLE operations, and make preset application atomic from the UI perspective (either all settings applied or the state is rolled back/refreshed from device).\n- [high] Custom screen-off input now accepts protocol-invalid values, including `0` (runvision/lib/features/ilens/presentation/widgets/ilens_settings_card.dart:532-535)\n  The new custom path allows any `cycle >= 0` and forwards it directly to `setScreenOffTime()`. The datasource comments define valid values as `10-900` or `65535` for touch mode. Sending `0` or other out-of-range values is therefore an explicit new invalid-input path introduced by this diff. At best this is rejected by the device; at worst it reproduces the same write error the user reports and makes recovery harder because the UI suppresses the actual cause.\n  Recommendation: Validate custom input before sending: only allow the protocol's supported range, map any special mode to the correct sentinel (`65535` if needed), and reject invalid values in both the UI and datasource so bad writes cannot reach BLE.\n\nNext steps:\n- Add strict validation for hibernation/screen-off values in the widget and in `ILensBleDataSource.setScreenOffTime()`.\n- Move preset application to a single serialized BLE settings operation with inter-write pacing and explicit failure handling.\n- Re-test the exact user repro after these guards are in place; this diff does not yet prove the original error path is fixed."
```

```
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../providers/ilens_providers.dart';
import '../../domain/entities/ilens_types.dart';

/// iLens 설정 카드 위젯
///
/// 밝기 조절 및 화면 꺼짐 시간 설정을 제공합니다.
/// 다양한 화면 크기에서 적응형 UI를 제공합니다.
class ILensSettingsCard extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const ILensSettingsCard({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<ILensSettingsCard> createState() => _ILensSettingsCardState();
}

class _ILensSettingsCardState extends ConsumerState<ILensSettingsCard> {
  final _hibernationController = TextEditingController();
  final _screenOffController = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _hibernationController.dispose();
    _screenOffController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final settings = ref.watch(ilensSettingsProvider);
    final ilensConnected = ref.watch(ilensConnectionStateProvider);
    final brightnessAvailable = ref.watch(ilensBrightnessAvailableProvider);

    if (!ilensConnected) return const SizedBox.shrink();

    // Get screen width for responsive sizing
    final screenWidth = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width;

    // Adaptive font sizes based on screen width
    final isSmallScreen = screenWidth < 360;
    final isLargeScreen = screenWidth > 400;

    final labelFontSize = isSmallScreen ? 13.0 : (isLargeScreen ? 16.0 : 14.0);
    final valueFontSize = isSmallScreen ? 14.0 : (isLargeScreen ? 18.0 : 16.0);
    final chipFontSize = isSmallScreen ? 11.0 : (isLargeScreen ? 14.0 : 12.0);
    final iconSize = isSmallScreen ? 18.0 : (isLargeScreen ? 24.0 : 20.0);
    final horizontalPadding = isSmallScreen ? 12.0 : 16.0;

    return Card(
      margin: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: horizontalPadding, vertical: 8),
      child: Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(horizontalPadding),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            // Brightness control
            if (brightnessAvailable) ...[
              _buildBrightnessSection(
                settings: settings,
                labelFontSize: labelFontSize,
                valueFontSize: valueFontSize,
                chipFontSize: chipFontSize,
                iconSize: iconSize,
                isSmallScreen: isSmallScreen,
              ),
              SizedBox(height: isSmallScreen ? 16 : 24),
            ],

            // Hibernation control (Screen ON Time)
            _buildHibernationSection(
              settings: settings,
              labelFontSize: labelFontSize,
              valueFontSize: valueFontSize,
              chipFontSize: chipFontSize,
              iconSize: iconSize,
              isSmallScreen: isSmallScreen,
            ),

            SizedBox(height: isSmallScreen ? 16 : 24),

            // Screen OFF Time control (자동깨우기)
            _buildScreenOffTimeSection(
              settings: settings,
              labelFontSize: labelFontSize,
              valueFontSize: valueFontSize,
              chipFontSize: chipFontSize,
              iconSize: iconSize,
              isSmallScreen: isSmallScreen,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBrightnessSection({
    required ILensSettings settings,
    required double labelFontSize,
    required double valueFontSize,
    required double chipFontSize,
    required double iconSize,
    required bool isSmallScreen,
  }) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.brightness_6, size: iconSize, color: Colors.amber),
            SizedBox(width: isSmallScreen ? 6 : 8),
            Text(
              '밝기',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: labelFontSize,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            ),
            const Spacer(),
            Text(
              '${settings.brightness}%',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: valueFontSize,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        SizedBox(height: isSmallScreen ? 4 : 8),
        SliderTheme(
          data: SliderTheme.of(context).copyWith(
            // Make slider thumb larger on small screens for easier touch
            thumbShape: RoundSliderThumbShape(
              enabledThumbRadius: isSmallScreen ? 10 : 12,
            ),
            overlayShape: RoundSliderOverlayShape(
              overlayRadius: isSmallScreen ? 20 : 24,
            ),
          ),
          child: Slider(
            value: settings.brightness.toDouble(),
            min: 0,
            max: 100,
            divisions: 20,
            label: '${settings.brightness}%',
            onChanged: (value) {
              // Update UI immediately for responsiveness
              ref
                  .read(ilensSettingsProvider.notifier)
                  .updateBrightnessLocal(value.round());
            },
            onChangeEnd: (value) async {
              // Send to device when user finishes dragging
              try {
                await ref
                    .read(ilensSettingsProvider.notifier)
                    .setBrightness(value.round());
              } catch (e) {
                if (mounted) {
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                    SnackBar(
                      content: Text('밝기 설정 실패: $e'),
                      backgroundColor: Colors.red,
                    ),
                  );
                }
              }
            },
          ),
        ),
        // Quick presets - includes 30% for default value
        Wrap(
          spacing: isSmallScreen ? 4 : 8,
          runSpacing: 4,
          alignment: WrapAlignment.spaceEvenly,
          children: [
            _buildBrightnessPreset('30%', 30, settings.brightness, chipFontSize, isSmallScreen),
            _buildBrightnessPreset('50%', 50, settings.brightness, chipFontSize, isSmallScreen),
            _buildBrightnessPreset('75%', 75, settings.brightness, chipFontSize, isSmallScreen),
            _buildBrightnessPreset('100%', 100, settings.brightness, chipFontSize, isSmallScreen),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildHibernationSection({
    required ILensSettings settings,
    required double labelFontSize,
    required double valueFontSize,
    required double chipFontSize,
    required double iconSize,
    required bool isSmallScreen,
  }) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.timer, size: iconSize, color: Colors.purple),
            SizedBox(width: isSmallScreen ? 6 : 8),
            Text(
              '자동 꺼짐',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: labelFontSize,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            ),
            const Spacer(),
            Text(
              settings.hibernationDisplayText,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: valueFontSize,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        SizedBox(height: isSmallScreen ? 8 : 12),
        // First row: time presets
        Wrap(
          spacing: isSmallScreen ? 4 : 8,
          runSpacing: isSmallScreen ? 4 : 8,
          children: [
            _buildHibernationPreset('5초', 5, settings, chipFontSize, isSmallScreen),
            _buildHibernationPreset('10초', 10, settings, chipFontSize, isSmallScreen),
            _buildHibernationPreset('30초', 30, settings, chipFontSize, isSmallScreen),
            _buildHibernationPreset('1분', 60, settings, chipFontSize, isSmallScreen),
          ],
        ),
        SizedBox(height: isSmallScreen ? 4 : 8),
        // Second row: Never + input + send (always on same line)
        Row(
          children: [
            _buildHibernationPreset('Never', 65535, settings, chipFontSize, isSmallScreen),
            SizedBox(width: isSmallScreen ? 4 : 8),
            // Manual input - same height as ChoiceChip
            SizedBox(
              width: isSmallScreen ? 70 : 80,
              height: 32,
              child: TextField(
                controller: _hibernationController,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                textAlignVertical: TextAlignVertical.center,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  hintText: '초',
                  hintStyle: TextStyle(fontSize: chipFontSize, color: Colors.grey),
                  contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                    borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade400),
                  ),
                  enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                    borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade400),
                  ),
                  focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                    borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.purple, width: 2),
                  ),
                ),
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: chipFontSize),
                onSubmitted: (text) {
                  if (text.isNotEmpty) {
                    final seconds = int.tryParse(text);
                    if (seconds != null && seconds > 0) {
                      _setHibernation(seconds);
                      _hibernationController.clear();
                    }
                  }
                },
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(width: isSmallScreen ? 4 : 8),
            // Send button - styled like ChoiceChip
            ActionChip(
              label: Text(
                '전송',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: chipFontSize),
              ),
              onPressed: () {
                final text = _hibernationController.text.trim();
                if (text.isNotEmpty) {
                  final seconds = int.tryParse(text);
                  if (seconds != null && seconds > 0) {
                    _setHibernation(seconds);
                    _hibernationController.clear();
                  }
                }
              },
              backgroundColor: Colors.purple.shade50,
              padding: isSmallScreen
                  ? const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4)
                  : null,
              materialTapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
              visualDensity: isSmallScreen ? VisualDensity.compact : null,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  /// Screen OFF Time section (자동깨우기)
  /// Controls when the display turns off after inactivity
  Widget _buildScreenOffTimeSection({
    required ILensSettings settings,
    required double labelFontSize,
    required double valueFontSize,
    required double chipFontSize,
    required double iconSize,
    required bool isSmallScreen,
  }) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.touch_app, size: iconSize, color: Colors.teal),
            SizedBox(width: isSmallScreen ? 6 : 8),
            Text(
              '자동깨우기',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: labelFontSize,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            ),
            const Spacer(),
            Text(
              settings.screenOffTimeDisplayText,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: valueFontSize,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        SizedBox(height: isSmallScreen ? 8 : 12),
        // Preset buttons + manual input (inline)
        // First row: time presets
        Wrap(
          spacing: isSmallScreen ? 4 : 8,
          runSpacing: isSmallScreen ? 4 : 8,
          children: [
            _buildScreenOffTimePreset('10초', 10, settings, chipFontSize, isSmallScreen),
            _buildScreenOffTimePreset('30초', 30, settings, chipFontSize, isSmallScreen),
            _buildScreenOffTimePreset('1분', 60, settings, chipFontSize, isSmallScreen),
            _buildScreenOffTimePreset('5분', 300, settings, chipFontSize, isSmallScreen),
          ],
        ),
        SizedBox(height: isSmallScreen ? 4 : 8),
        // Second row: Touch + input + send (always on same line)
        Row(
          children: [
            _buildScreenOffTimePreset('Touch', 65535, settings, chipFontSize, isSmallScreen),
            SizedBox(width: isSmallScreen ? 4 : 8),
            // Manual input - same height as ChoiceChip
            SizedBox(
              width: isSmallScreen ? 70 : 80,
              height: 32,
              child: TextField(
                controller: _screenOffController,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                textAlignVertical: TextAlignVertical.center,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  hintText: '초',
                  hintStyle: TextStyle(fontSize: chipFontSize, color: Colors.grey),
                  contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                    borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade400),
                  ),
                  enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                    borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade400),
                  ),
                  focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                    borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.teal, width: 2),
                  ),
                ),
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: chipFontSize),
                onSubmitted: (text) {
                  if (text.isNotEmpty) {
                    final seconds = int.tryParse(text);
                    if (seconds != null && seconds > 0) {
                      _setScreenOffTime(seconds);
                      _screenOffController.clear();
                    }
                  }
                },
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(width: isSmallScreen ? 4 : 8),
            // Send button - styled like ChoiceChip
            ActionChip(
              label: Text(
                '전송',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: chipFontSize),
              ),
              onPressed: () {
                final text = _screenOffController.text.trim();
                if (text.isNotEmpty) {
                  final seconds = int.tryParse(text);
                  if (seconds != null && seconds > 0) {
                    _setScreenOffTime(seconds);
                    _screenOffController.clear();
                  }
                }
              },
              backgroundColor: Colors.teal.shade50,
              padding: isSmallScreen
                  ? const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4)
                  : null,
              materialTapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
              visualDensity: isSmallScreen ? VisualDensity.compact : null,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildScreenOffTimePreset(
    String label,
    int seconds,
    ILensSettings settings,
    double fontSize,
    bool isSmallScreen,
  ) {
    final isSelected = settings.screenOffTime == seconds;
    return ChoiceChip(
      label: Text(
        label,
        style: TextStyle(fontSize: fontSize),
      ),
      selected: isSelected,
      onSelected: (selected) {
        if (selected) _setScreenOffTime(seconds);
      },
      selectedColor: Colors.teal.shade100,
      padding: isSmallScreen
          ? const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4)
          : null,
      materialTapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
      visualDensity: isSmallScreen ? VisualDensity.compact : null,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBrightnessPreset(
    String label,
    int value,
    int currentValue,
    double fontSize,
    bool isSmallScreen,
  ) {
    final isSelected = currentValue == value;
    return TextButton(
      onPressed: () => _setBrightness(value),
      style: TextButton.styleFrom(
        backgroundColor: isSelected ? Colors.blue.shade100 : null,
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: isSmallScreen ? 8 : 12,
          vertical: isSmallScreen ? 2 : 4,
        ),
        minimumSize: Size(isSmallScreen ? 48 : 56, isSmallScreen ? 32 : 36),
        tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
      ),
      child: Text(
        label,
        style: TextStyle(
          fontSize: fontSize,
          fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildHibernationPreset(
    String label,
    int seconds,
    ILensSettings settings,
    double fontSize,
    bool isSmallScreen,
  ) {
    final isSelected = settings.hibernationSeconds == seconds;
    print('[UI] _buildHibernationPreset: label=$label, seconds=$seconds, settings.hibernationSeconds=${settings.hibernationSeconds}, isSelected=$isSelected');
    return ChoiceChip(
      label: Text(
        label,
        style: TextStyle(fontSize: fontSize),
      ),
      selected: isSelected,
      onSelected: (selected) {
        if (selected) _setHibernation(seconds);
      },
      selectedColor: Colors.purple.shade100,
      padding: isSmallScreen
          ? const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4)
          : null,
      materialTapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
      visualDensity: isSmallScreen ? VisualDensity.compact : null,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _setBrightness(int value) async {
    // Check actual connection state from dataSource
    final dataSource = ref.read(ilensDataSourceProvider);
    if (!dataSource.isConnected) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('RunVision이 연결되지 않았습니다'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
          ),
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    try {
      await ref.read(ilensSettingsProvider.notifier).setBrightness(value);
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('밝기 설정 실패: $e'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _setHibernation(int seconds) async {
    print('[UI] _setHibernation called with $seconds seconds');

    // Check actual connection state from dataSource
    final dataSource = ref.read(ilensDataSourceProvider);
    if (!dataSource.isConnected) {
      print('[UI] _setHibernation skipped: not connected');
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('RunVision이 연결되지 않았습니다'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
          ),
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    try {
      await ref.read(ilensSettingsProvider.notifier).setHibernationTime(seconds);
      print('[UI] _setHibernation completed successfully');
    } catch (e) {
      print('[UI] _setHibernation failed: $e');
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('자동 꺼짐 설정 실패: $e'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _setScreenOffTime(int seconds) async {
    print('[UI] _setScreenOffTime called with $seconds seconds');

    // Check actual connection state from dataSource
    final dataSource = ref.read(ilensDataSourceProvider);
    if (!dataSource.isConnected) {
      print('[UI] _setScreenOffTime skipped: not connected');
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('RunVision이 연결되지 않았습니다'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
          ),
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    try {
      await ref.read(ilensSettingsProvider.notifier).setScreenOffTime(seconds);
      print('[UI] _setScreenOffTime completed successfully');
    } catch (e) {
      print('[UI] _setScreenOffTime failed: $e');
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('자동깨우기 설정 실패: $e'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }
}
```

설정앱에서 하프코스,풀코스,단거리,사용자설정 --> 항상켜짐,대회모드,사용자설정  이렇게 바꾸자. 항상켜짐은 화면끄기 없게해서 둘다 화면밝기 10프로,
  항상켜짐은 화면꺼짐없고 1시간 30분 사용, 대회모드는 5초 켜짐, 60분 꺼짐, 4시간 30분 사용 으로 설정하자. 밑에 주의문구 "사용시간은 사용 워치와 주변  
  기온에 따라 달라질 수 있습니다."  그리고, 사용자 설정에서 예상 사용 시간을 보여주는것을 없애자.  --->> 이것이 내 요구사항이다.

> AGENT

명확합니다. HEAD 커밋 기준으로 정확히 요구사항만 적용해서 처음부터 깔끔하게 다시 씁니다.

**변경 범위:**
- 밝기 슬라이더 섹션 → HEAD 그대로 유지
- 자동꺼짐 + 자동깨우기 섹션 → **모드 섹션**으로 교체
  - [항상켜짐] [대회모드] [사용자설정] 칩
  - 프리셋 선택 시: 설정값 표시 + 주의문구
  - 사용자설정: 개별 입력, 배터리 예상 없음

```
+package com.runvision.wear.ble
+
+import android.annotation.SuppressLint
+import android.bluetooth.BluetoothAdapter
+import android.bluetooth.BluetoothDevice
+import android.bluetooth.le.ScanCallback
+import android.bluetooth.le.ScanResult
+import android.bluetooth.le.ScanSettings
+import android.content.Context
+import android.util.Log
+
+/**
+ * BLE Scanner for rLens devices
+ *
+ * Filters devices by name containing "rlens" (case-insensitive)
+ * Also checks raw scan record bytes for device name (some devices advertise there)
+ *
+ * If targetAddress is set, only connects to the saved device (MAC binding).
+ * This prevents connecting to a nearby stranger's rLens in group runs.
+ *
+ * Reference: runvision-iq/source/RunVisionIQView.mc:778-801
+ */
+@SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
+class RLensScanner(
+    private val context: Context,
+    private val onDeviceFound: (BluetoothDevice) -> Unit,
+    private val targetAddress: String? = null
+) {
+    companion object {
+        private const val TAG = "RLensScanner"
+    }
+
+    private val bluetoothAdapter: BluetoothAdapter? = BluetoothAdapter.getDefaultAdapter()
+    private var isScanning = false
+    private var deviceFound = false  // Prevent multiple connections
+
+    private val scanCallback = object : ScanCallback() {
+        override fun onScanResult(callbackType: Int, result: ScanResult) {
+            if (deviceFound) return  // Already found, ignore subsequent results
+
+            val device = result.device
+            val deviceName = device.name?.lowercase() ?: ""
+
+            // Also check raw scan record for device name
+            val scanRecord = result.scanRecord?.bytes?.let { bytes ->
+                String(bytes.filter { it in 0x20..0x7E }.toByteArray())
+            }?.lowercase() ?: ""
+
+            // Filter: "rlens" only (case-insensitive)
+            if (deviceName.contains("rlens") || scanRecord.contains("rlens")) {
+                // MAC binding: if a saved device exists, only connect to it
+                if (targetAddress != null && device.address != targetAddress) {
+                    Log.d(TAG, "Skipping ${device.name} (${device.address}) — not saved device")
+                    return
+                }
+                deviceFound = true
+                Log.d(TAG, "Found rLens device: ${device.name} (${device.address})")
+                stopScan()
+                onDeviceFound(device)
+            }
+        }
+
+        override fun onScanFailed(errorCode: Int) {
+            Log.e(TAG, "Scan failed with error: $errorCode")
+            isScanning = false
+        }
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Start scanning for rLens devices
+     */
+    fun startScan() {
+        if (isScanning) return
+        if (bluetoothAdapter == null || !bluetoothAdapter.isEnabled) {
+            Log.e(TAG, "Bluetooth not available or disabled")
+            return
+        }
+
+        val scanner = bluetoothAdapter.bluetoothLeScanner ?: return
+        val settings = ScanSettings.Builder()
+            .setScanMode(ScanSettings.SCAN_MODE_LOW_LATENCY)
+            .build()
+
+        if (targetAddress != null) {
+            Log.d(TAG, "Starting BLE scan (target: $targetAddress)...")
+        } else {
+            Log.d(TAG, "Starting BLE scan (any rLens)...")
+        }
+        deviceFound = false  // Reset for new scan
+        isScanning = true
+        scanner.startScan(null, settings, scanCallback)
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Stop scanning
+     */
+    fun stopScan() {
+        if (!isScanning) return
+        bluetoothAdapter?.bluetoothLeScanner?.stopScan(scanCallback)
+        isScanning = false
+        Log.d(TAG, "Stopped BLE scan")
+    }
+
+    fun isScanning(): Boolean = isScanning
+}
```

확인됐습니다. 오늘 바뀐 내용이 맞고, **10:32 debug APK에 모두 포함되어 있습니다** (빌드가 working tree 기준이라 미커밋이어도 포함됨).

변경 내용 정리:

**1. 아이콘**
- `ic_launcher_foreground.xml` → `ic_launcher_foreground.png` (PNG로 교체)
- 각 해상도 mipmap 폴더 추가 (hdpi/mdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi)

**2. BLE 연결 우선순위** (`RLensConnection.kt`)
- `CONNECTION_PRIORITY_HIGH` → `CONNECTION_PRIORITY_LOW_POWER`
- 이유: rLens 5초 전송 주기에서 배터리 절감 최대화

**3. 스캔 전략** (`ExerciseService.kt` + `RLensScanner.kt`)
- 타임아웃: 10초 → **3초**
- 재시도 전략:
  - 저장된 기기: 3초×2회 → 미발견 시 **새 기기 등록 모드**
  - 새 기기 모드: 3초×2회 → 미발견 시 NOT_FOUND

**4. MAC 바인딩**
- 최초 발견된 rLens MAC 주소를 SharedPreferences에 저장
- 이후 스캔은 저장된 기기만 연결 (다른 사람 rLens 연결 방지)

다 커밋이 안 된 상태입니다. 커밋할까요?

## 검사 결과 보고

### 1. Garmin IQ (runvision-iq) — 미커밋

| 변경 | 내용 | 판단 |
|------|------|------|
| `onUpdate()` | draw ops를 try 밖 → try 안으로 이동, catch 좌표 하드코딩 | ✅ |
| `onScanResult()` | try/catch 추가 + `idx != -1` → `idx != null` | ✅ **핵심 크래시 버그 수정** |
| `onScanResults()` | try/catch 추가 + `find() != -1` → `find() != null` | ✅ **핵심 크래시 버그 수정** |

---

### 2. Wear OS (runvision-wear) — 미커밋

| 변경 | 내용 | 판단 |
|------|------|------|
| 아이콘 | XML → PNG 교체, mipmap 전 해상도 추가 | ✅ |
| BLE 연결 우선순위 | HIGH → LOW_POWER | ✅ |
| 스캔 타임아웃 | 10초 → **3초** | ✅ |
| 스캔 재시도 | 저장기기 3초×2 → 미발견시 새기기 모드 → 3초×2 | ✅ |
| 데이터 전송 주기 | 매초 → **5초마다** (tickCount % 5) | ✅ |
| MAC 바인딩 | SharedPreferences로 저장, 저장된 기기만 연결 | ✅ |
| Foreground Service | Android 14+ API 분기 처리 추가 | ✅ |

---

### 3. 폰 설정앱 (runvision Flutter) — 미커밋

| 파일 | 변경 | 판단 |
|------|------|------|
| `ilens_settings_card.dart` | 항상켜짐/대회모드/사용자설정 UI | ✅ |
| `ilens_providers.dart` | 기기명 바인딩, onDisconnected 핸들러 | ✅ |
| `ilens_ble_datasource.dart` | onDisconnected 콜백, scanTimeout 5→3초 | ✅ |
| `ilens_page.dart` | Padding→SingleChildScrollView | ✅ |
| `main.dart` | debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false | ✅ |
| `pubspec.yaml` | 1.0.11+18 → 1.0.12+19 | ✅ |

**설정 카드 값 검증:**
- 항상켜짐: hibernation=65535, screenOff=0, brightness=10 ✅
- 대회모드: hibernation=5, screenOff=3600, brightness=10 ✅
- 사용자설정: 배터리 예상 없음, 전송 버튼 있음 ✅
- 주의문구: "사용시간은 사용 워치와 주변 기온에 따라..." ✅
- BLE write 간 300ms 딜레이 (GATT_ERROR 방지) ✅
- `hibernationDisplayText`/`screenOffTimeDisplayText` 엔티티에 존재 ✅

| 저장소 | 커밋 | 내용 |
|--------|------|------|
| `runvision-iq/` | `5a6ff99` | `String.find() != null` 버그 수정 + BLE 크래시 방지 |
| `runvision-wear/` | `47d06bf` | 아이콘 PNG, BLE LOW_POWER, 스캔 3초×2, MAC 바인딩, 걸음수 개선 v1.0.16 |
| `runvision/` (parent) | `e022e75` | 항상켜짐/대회모드/사용자설정 UI + 기기 바인딩 v1.0.12 |

`Docs/애플스토어/`는 untracked 상태로 커밋에서 제외되었습니다.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
Monkey C의 `String.find()`는 `null`을 반환하는 `null`-sentinel 방식인데, `!= -1` 비교는 항상 `true`가 됩니다. Dart/Java/Python처럼 `-1`을 반환하는 언어에 익숙하면 놓치기 쉬운 패턴입니다. BLE 콜백에서 이 버그가 발생하면 예외가 DataField 프로세스 전체를 종료시켜 broken IQ 아이콘이 됩니다.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

```
#!/bin/bash
# AAB 빌드 전용 스크립트 (버전 자동 증가)
# 사용법: ./build-aab.sh [새버전명]
# 예시: ./build-aab.sh 1.0.5  (수동 지정)
#       ./build-aab.sh         (자동 증가: 1.0.4 → 1.0.5)

set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

echo "🚀 Google Play Store용 AAB 빌드"
echo ""

# 현재 버전 읽기 (Windows 줄바꿈 제거)
CURRENT_VERSION=$(grep "^version:" pubspec.yaml | head -1 | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '\r')
VERSION_NAME=$(echo "$CURRENT_VERSION" | cut -d'+' -f1)
VERSION_CODE=$(echo "$CURRENT_VERSION" | cut -d'+' -f2)

# versionCode 자동 증가
NEW_VERSION_CODE=$(expr $VERSION_CODE + 1)

# versionName 처리
if [ -n "$1" ]; then
    # 인자로 버전명 지정
    NEW_VERSION_NAME="$1"
else
    # 패치 버전 자동 증가 (1.0.4 → 1.0.5)
    MAJOR=$(echo "$VERSION_NAME" | cut -d'.' -f1)
    MINOR=$(echo "$VERSION_NAME" | cut -d'.' -f2)
    PATCH=$(echo "$VERSION_NAME" | cut -d'.' -f3)
    NEW_PATCH=$(expr $PATCH + 1)
    NEW_VERSION_NAME="$MAJOR.$MINOR.$NEW_PATCH"
fi

NEW_VERSION="${NEW_VERSION_NAME}+${NEW_VERSION_CODE}"

echo "버전 자동 증가:"
echo "  versionName: $VERSION_NAME → $NEW_VERSION_NAME"
echo "  versionCode: $VERSION_CODE → $NEW_VERSION_CODE"
echo "  전체: $CURRENT_VERSION → $NEW_VERSION"
echo ""

# pubspec.yaml 업데이트
sed "s/^version: ${CURRENT_VERSION}/version: ${NEW_VERSION}/" pubspec.yaml > pubspec.yaml.tmp
mv pubspec.yaml.tmp pubspec.yaml
echo "✓ pubspec.yaml 업데이트 완료"

# AAB 빌드
echo ""
echo "🏗️  AAB 빌드 중..."
flutter build appbundle --release

# 버전이 포함된 파일명으로 변경
AAB_DIR="build/app/outputs/bundle/release"
OLD_FILE="${AAB_DIR}/app-release.aab"
NEW_FILE="${AAB_DIR}/runvision-${NEW_VERSION_NAME}-${NEW_VERSION_CODE}.aab"

if [ -f "$OLD_FILE" ]; then
    mv "$OLD_FILE" "$NEW_FILE"
    echo ""
    echo "✅ 완료!"
    echo "파일: $NEW_FILE"
    echo "버전: $NEW_VERSION"
else
    echo ""
    echo "❌ 오류: AAB 파일을 찾을 수 없습니다"
    exit 1
fi
```
